entity: Share of Texas (ERCOT) gas capacity able to switch to oil, before vs after the 2021 freeze
why: Same entity numbers exist but under different definitions: ERCOT's FFSS procurement (2,940.5 MW of contracted fuel-oil reserve) is not the total dual-fuel share, and EIA's 19% of NGCC is national, not Texas. No source states the 4.9%-to-6.0% rise, and nothing else matches.
